evals.name: cold-start-with-answers
evals.prompt: Quiero automatizar esto en este repo usando el use-case builder de Forjate: los proveedores mandan facturas en PDF a una casilla compartida, hoy una persona tipea proveedor, monto, fecha y número de orden de compra en el ERP (Odoo) y marca las que no coinciden con la orden. Quiero que lo haga un agente y que una persona apruebe solo las excepciones. No me hagas preguntas, estas son las respuestas: documentos en español; sin context packs; la métrica es el porcentaje de facturas posteadas sin tipeo manual, hoy 0%, objetivo 80%; los datos son financieros y hay números de cuenta bancaria, deben quedar en la UE y no pueden salir a un proveedor de modelos externo; aprueba el CFO; presupuesto 300 USD por mes; ambiente regulado; quiero llegar a producción. Dejá todo bajo k8s/overlays/usecases/<nombre>/.builder/ validado con plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py y terminá con el reporte de revisión. Stop after the stage plan is written and validated: do not run the expert agents, the scaffold or the assembly in this session.
evals.expected_output: brief.yaml (language es, classification financial, regulated, llm_egress_allowed false, stages crawl+walk+run), packs.yaml empty, stage-plan.yaml produced by the planner, log.md, report printed listing experts not yet available.

assertions.text: brief written under a derived name (invoice-intake)
validate.py passes on the use case
no expert record fabricated (the coordinator was told to stop at the plan)

evals.name: resume-does-not-reinterview
evals.prompt: Copy the directory plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/tests/fixtures/db-migration-a-to-b/.builder into k8s/overlays/usecases/db-migration-a-to-b/.builder (it has a brief, packs, a stage plan and one decision record). Then resume the Forjate use-case builder for the use case db-migration-a-to-b: continue from where it is, do not ask questions, do not rewrite artifacts that already validate, and end with the review report.
evals.expected_output: brief, stage-plan and decisions/data-store.yaml untouched; log.md appended; report lists the experts without a record under 'Not yet available'; no new decision records fabricated.

evals.name: vague-prompt-records-assumptions
evals.prompt: Use the Forjate use-case builder in this repo to set up a use case for: 'we get a lot of support emails and want AI to help'. Nobody is available to answer questions, so proceed on your own and leave everything under k8s/overlays/usecases/<name>/.builder/, validated with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py. Stop after the stage plan is written and validated: do not run the expert agents, the scaffold or the assembly.
evals.expected_output: A valid brief whose constraints.notes carries ASSUMED: lines for language, packs, classification (pii), egress, stages; stage plan produced; no fabricated expert records.

assertions.text: assumptions recorded explicitly in the brief

evals.name: review-tenant-drift
evals.prompt: Copy plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/tenant-drift/ to /tmp/acme-iac (the directory must contain CLAUDE.md and k8s/). Then, as the Forjate use-case builder coordinator in review mode run from inside that tenant repository (cd /tmp/acme-iac), produce the review for a use case named invoice-intake that has no artifacts yet, and write exactly what you would print to k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake-review.md in this repository (create the directory). The review must start with what the tenant's CLAUDE.md gets wrong about its own tree.
evals.expected_output: A 'Tenant drift' section first: gitops/production and gitops/testing documented but missing, k8s/namespaces/stale not referenced from the root, k8s/patches and k8s/namespaces undocumented, the ?ref=develop branch ref; then the report with every section reading 'not yet produced'.

assertions.text: the documented gitops/ tree that does not exist is listed
the dead namespace directory is listed
the branch ref is listed as drift
sections for missing artifacts say so instead of guessing
the CLAUDE.md's description of the write-back is not repeated as fact
